name: KutilXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP, plus imagined Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC across three screens. Tap a jack then another to patch, cables run between screens, and a tap on a module's empty art opens a window with just its jacks, big and named, so you can patch from one module to another.
